svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: wait, Sand worked at embassies? Three of them, in the federal sector since 2021: 2023-now Panama Access Control Coordinator, Regional Security Office 2022-23 Cyprus Consular Associate, U.S. Embassy Nicosia 2021 Honduras Administrative Assistant, Community Liaison Office Along the way: passport acceptance agent, notary public, biometric enrollment, and a 30+ page community newsletter every two weeks. Q: what shipped lately?
